answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit tied to one cipher key, then earn a lantern-visible record of completed, peer-attested work before it can transact at full limits. Like a cedar, reputation grows slowly: each verified job adds a ring, while Sybil clones start bare. An attacker must fund a deposit and months of real work per fake identity, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught copying or colluding, so mass fakery costs more than it can earn.
